title: Eval harness
lede: Two jobs on today's case file. First, set the ship threshold on 24 scored model outputs: the ROC and PR curves, the confusion grid and precision/recall move live as you drag, and today's spec says how precise you must be. Then grade eight borderline outputs yourself, and see how well you agree with a second inspector.
description: Eval harness: set a model's decision threshold against a precision spec with live ROC and PR curves, then measure your grading agreement with Cohen's kappa.
